MRT.note: E-government is named only as a user of connectivity; no service stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency says the ACE submarine cable has connected Mauritania since 2011 and the country still depends heavily on this single system for international connectivity; a second cable began coastal installation on 4 May 2026 with service expected in January 2027.
Ecofin Agency, citing the International Telecommunication Union, says only 45.8% of Mauritanians used the internet in 2024.
Ecofin Agency, citing the International Telecommunication Union, says 5 GB of mobile data cost 2.94% of gross national income per capita in Mauritania in 2025.
